response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with nearly 20 years of software development experience and genuine developer-tooling contributions (test frameworks, CI infrastructure, MCP code generators). However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring at least 2 years of formal people leadership and 3 years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change. Mobile-platform experience is limited to a brief iOS/Apple TV stint a decade ago, and there is no track record of roadmap ownership at team or org level.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (18+ years) across web, mobile, embedded, and high-scale backend systems
Authentic developer-tools background: test runners (Trial), assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, and AI-agent/MCP tooling
Demonstrated mentorship inclination via workshops, courses, and code katas — a soft signal for people development
concerns: No formal people-management or team-leadership experience, a hard requirement for this Level II Manager role
No demonstrated strategic roadmap ownership or organizational change leadership
Mobile-platform experience is shallow and dated (single iOS/Apple TV project ~2015–2016)

key_factors.factor: Limited mobile-platform and roadmap leadership experience
